user.title: Connect to Quitoque
user.description:
Enter your Quitoque credentials.

The integration only manages deliveries scheduled in 2, 3 and 4 weeks (W+2, W+3 and W+4). Recipes are created as one-hour events on the delivery day, spread between 08:00 and 11:00. The title keeps the week number and may start with a custom prefix.

During synchronization, active boxes for W+2 to W+4 are imported and weeks already present in the calendar are skipped, even if their events were moved elsewhere during the year. The synchronization button is unavailable when no active delivery is planned.

Generated PDFs are automatically deleted after the configured retention period.
